notes.title: What is this game ?
notes.notes:
Hello first of all;

Part 1 of the game is now available for download. For the full release date, I foresee a period of 1 year - 8 months.
Some parts of the game primarily; Optimization, combat mechanics and animations, dialogues, storytelling and graphics were not what I wanted for the reasons I will explain.
At first, the excitement and rookieness of my first game comes. But there are many mistakes that I noticed when I came to the end of the feedback and the Early Access project. (especially in the battle scene :D) I started by correcting them first.
Secondly, my hardware problems. Since my computer is bad, it forces my work in areas such as graphics and lighting (forcing, 18 days of waiting time for light rendering, etc.) and now I am afraid that something will happen to my computer when I put it on.
Thirdly, because of the time I spend on the game, I am no longer neutral and cannot perceive what is good and what is bad. In other words, I will take into account the feedback from you while developing the game, and I need it.
Fourth, my financial problems. With the increase in exchange rates in my country, my student body began to be unable to stand it. :D
Now I've started recoding the game and re-editing it on my own floor. For part 1, which is currently in early access; 40% of the story is playable with current enjoyment.
It just didn't turn out the way I had imagined. By arranging them, I will bring the game to the full version. If you are asking what will happen if we see a bug, hang-up, or something missing in part 1 or the pre-alpha part. Let me know right away on twitter or disort. I'll deal with it as soon as possible.
I will share the progress of the full version on my Discord channel, on my twitter page, on reddit weekly. I am very satisfied with the feedback I have received for what I have shared so far. And it accelerated.

Updates to be added to the game;
climbing mechanics
mount mechanics
chariots
raft mechanics
board game
More advanced melee mechanics and animations
More advanced Bow handling mechanics and animations
A more advanced AI
More advanced Graphics
More NPCs to interact with
Missions that are more integrated into the story
Side quests that will increase your enjoyment more in the game
Tombs, interior designs of pyramids (with more labyrinth and platformer items)
In addition to this I need to add a few more cities and villages for the content of my story.
